description:
### Bou 1.4.7

* AI mode: fixed "key not accepted (HTTP 400)". Google's newest Gemini models refused the old thinking setting; the key itself was fine
* AI mode waits a little longer (2.5 s) so more sentences get the AI result
* Author shown as Subrata Mohajan (based on PixelBoard by Akshay Kadam)

Supports Gboard 18.6.3.100 (arm64).
